title: Let’s repeat what we learned
intro: Cleanliness, wudu, Surah An-Nas – let’s repeat!

learn.html: Let’s repeat! Say the missing words with your muallim:

items: Allah loves tidiness and ______, especially when we ______. The Prophet (SAW) said: “Cleanliness is half of ______.”

Wudu is the religious ______ of parts of the body for ______ and reciting the ______.
